description: Land Acquisition - Udumulla, Kolonnawa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a Land Acquisition Notice published under The Land Acquisition Act. It specifically describes the government's intention to acquire two specific plots of land (including their location, extent, and claimants) for a development project. The content is entirely focused on land acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category for land and property-related matters.
